description_en: Queries the task result list to retrieve detailed SAST or SCA results for a specific scan
description_zh: 查询任务结果列表的接口，用于获取某次扫描的 SAST 或 SCA 详细结果
name: DescribeScanResultsByEngine

parameters.help_en:
The engine type. Valid values:
sast
sca
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not pass nextToken or pass an empty string for the first page. To retrieve the next page, pass the nextToken value from the previous response without any modification. When the nextToken in the response is empty, you have reached the last page
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token，首页不传 nextToken 省略或为空字符串，翻页原样回传把上一次响应的 nextToken 值不做任何修改地传入下一次请求，响应中 nextToken 为空，已到最后一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量。默认 10，最大支持 50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Filters results by incremental scan baseline status. Valid values: new, unchanged, absent, updated
parameters.help_zh: 按增量扫描 baseline 状态过滤，可选 new / unchanged / absent / updated
parameters.name: baseline_state

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy match by component name. This parameter takes effect only when engine is set to sca
parameters.help_zh: 仅 engine=sca 时生效，按组件名模糊查询
parameters.name: package_name

parameters.help_en:
The language. Valid values:
zh: Chinese (default).
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言取值：
zh：中文（默认 ）
en：英文
parameters.name: lang
